thread:
michael: heads-up — canary for payments-service stalled during postupgrade checks after values bump (cpu/memory). deploy-bot paused the rollout and pinned the canary to v2.3.4. Do we want an immediate rollback or a targeted values hotfix?
jenna: saw the pause. logs show liveness failures on high load. quick rollback to v2.3.3 buys time.
olivia: agree with rollback. but we need to update release notes + change window record before we flip. Change window open for 30m, we can do a rollback + quick follow-up patch.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary health check failed: 2/3 pods not ready. Action: PAUSE. Pinned release: payments-service==v2.3.4 -> staged pin applied. To proceed run: `./scripts/deploy rollback payments-service --to v2.3.3 --reason "canary liveness"`
michael: thanks @deploy-bot. I'll run rollback now. tagging @sre-oncall for post-rollback monitoring.
jenna: quick diff of values that triggered it: ```diff
- replicas: 2
- resources:
-   requests:
-     cpu: 500m
+ replicas: 3
+ resources:
+   requests:
+     cpu: 800m
```
jenna: looks like the additional replica + higher cpu request pushed some pods onto smaller nodes, OOMs/liveness flaps.
olivia: for release notes: add bullet "reverted values change causing liveness flaps under burst load; follow-up patch will reintroduce with node-selection affinity". Also record change window: 2026-03-20 14:00-14:30 UTC.
sre-oncall: rolling back now, will watch pod restarts and P95 latency for the next 10m. If we see >3x baseline errors escalate to pager.
michael: rollback complete: `helm upgrade payments-service ./charts/payments --version 2.3.3 --values values-prod.yaml` -> STATUS: deployed. Rolling monitors.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Unpinning canary. Note: automated canary sequence will resume after manual approval.
jenna: filing a short-hotfix PR to revert the cpu+replica change and add nodeAffinity + podAntiAffinity. I'll link PR and update release notes.
olivia: thanks. Michael — please add a one-line summary to the release notes doc under "urgent reverts" so docs team can pick it up.
michael: done — added note and link to PR #8421.
sre-oncall: metrics look stable, p95 back to normal, no new errors. closing incident. :thumbsup:
jenna: will schedule a follow-up canary for tomorrow's afternoon window with tighter resource targets and affinity hints.
michael: +1. Closing thread.
